content_sections.heading: About NIT Nagaland
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Nagaland is an Institute of National Importance under MoE, Govt. of India, located at Chümoukedima, Nagaland. This notice is issued by its Registrar and is for a time-bound research project in the Department of Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering. The post is temporary and purely on a contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering / Electronics and Instrumentation Communication Engineering / Electrical Engineering / Materials Science or an equivalent discipline. Research experience in thin-film deposition techniques and material characterization. The age limit printed in the notice is 28 Yrs. The notice prints no date for counting age. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to scheduled castes/tribes/OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates. The notice also says relaxation is as per CSIR norms. For the discipline-specific eligibility, see the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Integrated BS-MS/MSc/BE/BTech or equivalent degree, with 55% marks and passing of NET/GATE test

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is Rs.37,000/- p.m. plus 8% HRA, applicable only if hostel or accommodation is not provided. The project tenure is three years or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier. The appointment is purely temporary on a contractual basis and will be renewed every six months/year, subject to satisfactory performance or until the completion of the project.

content_sections.heading: NIT Nagaland Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Synthesis and fabrication of NiSnO3 thin films through thermal co-evaporation. Fabrication of nanostructured ZnO films using spin-coating techniques. Integration of the films into heterostructure-based UV-A photodetectors. Data analysis, preparation of research publications, project reports and other project-related activities.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Nagaland Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Use the prescribed application format printed on pages 4 to 6 of the notice. Only applications in the prescribed format are accepted. Compile the application, all supporting documents and the CV in a single .PDF file. Email the file to [email protected] on or before 17:00 hours on 16 December 2026. Wait for the interview date, which the notice says will be sent by email to shortlisted candidates. With the email: the application in the prescribed format, supporting documents and CV in one .PDF file. The application form asks for self-attested certificates from High School onwards, details of the NET/GATE or equivalent qualifying exam, a list of publications and patents if available, a copy of the experience certificate and details of two referees. At the interview: original mark sheets, degree, certificates, age proof and other testimonials. At the interview: one set of photocopies of all certificates and one passport size self-attested photo.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates with appropriate qualifications in the relevant subject/specialization, consistently good academic records and experience may apply. Shortlisted candidates are notified by email for the interview. The tentative date of the interview is 18 December 2026, in hybrid mode. Original certificates are shown at the interview for verification.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there at NIT Nagaland?
faq.answer: The notice announces 01 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Nagaland JRF post?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed on or before 17:00 hours on 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIT Nagaland JRF post?
faq.answer: An Integrated BS-MS/MSc/BE/BTech or equivalent degree with 55% marks and passing of NET/GATE test is the essential qualification, as per CSIR Guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIT Nagaland JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 Yrs. It is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to scheduled castes/tribes/OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the NIT Nagaland JRF post?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs.37,000/- p.m. plus 8% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIT Nagaland JRF post?
faq.answer: Email the application in the prescribed format, with supporting documents and CV compiled in a single .PDF file, to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for the NIT Nagaland JRF post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are informed by email and called for an interview, tentatively on 18 December 2026 in hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIT Nagaland JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary on a contractual basis, renewed every six months/year, subject to satisfactory performance or until the completion of the project. The project tenure is three years or till completion, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the NIT Nagaland JRF interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA is paid to candidates for attending the interview.
